name: The Flake
tagline: A conspiracy theorist who turns out to be right. You spot the hidden patterns behind the monsters, and nobody takes you seriously until it counts.
luckSpecial: Whenever you burn a Luck point, name one thing about the scene you are in. The Keeper then reveals what other conspiracies that thing is linked to.

moves.intro: Besides the basic moves, you choose three Flake moves from the list below. Nothing is handed to you for free.

choices.name: Connect the Dots
choices.trig: At the start of a mystery, when you search for the larger pattern that events might belong to
choices.note: Hold is spent during the mystery, one point per question put to the Keeper. Choose from: Is someone tied to events more than they admit? Where and when is the next key event? Which thing does the monster want from a particular person? Does this link to mysteries we already worked? How does it fit the big picture?

choices.name: Crazy Eyes
choices.summary: Your Weird goes up by 1, to a maximum of +3.

choices.name: See, It All Fits Together
choices.summary: When you manipulate someone, you may use Sharp instead of Charm.

choices.name: Suspicious Mind
choices.summary: You can always tell when someone is lying to you.

choices.name: Often Overlooked
choices.trig: When you act all crazy to avoid something
choices.full: People see you as both unthreatening and unimportant.
choices.part: Pick one: they see you as unthreatening, or as unimportant.
choices.miss: You attract lots of attention (though not all of it).

choices.name: Contrary
choices.summary: If you ask someone for their honest opinion on the best thing for you to do, then go a different way, mark experience. If you do the exact reverse of what they said, you also get +1 ongoing to every move that follows that course.

choices.name: Net Friends
choices.trig: When you reach out to one of your online contacts for help on a mystery
choices.full: They are free and come through: they might repair something, crack a code, hack a system, or dig up special information.
choices.part: They will help, but it takes a while or you must do some of the work yourself.

choices.name: Sneaky
choices.summary: Attacking by surprise or from behind does +2 harm.

history: They are tied into the conspiracy somehow, and you have been watching them.
They are family. They decide what the exact relation is.
You are longtime friends whose paths crossed through a string of odd coincidences.
You survived something terrible together, such as a monster, the army or a stay in an institution. It forged complete trust between you.
You attend the same support group.
Everything seemed to point to teaming up, so you tracked them down and joined forces.
You know each other from cryptozoology and conspiracy websites.
